source: Japan Shogi Association, 将棋の指し方（手つきの所作） playlist (youtube.com/playlist?list=PL3Yk9nXcisMu8VawUEyTOJnF_jGc6yqkb). MediaPipe Hand Landmarker world landmarks, smoothed, solved to VRM right-hand finger bone rotations with Kalidokit Hand.solve (radians, XYZ euler, Kalidokit convention)

slide.about: Plain move: hand comes in flat, index and middle fingers on top of the piece, slide it one square and press

carry.about: Longer move: pinch with thumb, index and middle, lift and carry low, set down and press with index and middle pointing down

drop.about: Drop from hand: piece held upright between fingers and thumb, set down on the square, press with index and middle

capture.about: Capture: take the opponent piece off the square, then bring your own piece in and press

promote.about: Promotion: pinch, lift, turn the piece over in the fingers, set it down and press
